source: Plain Claude Code = baseline. Opus 5.5. Source: README.md, Results

pxpipe-gain-by-context.title: Adding pxpipe after RTK + Ponytail + Headroom: cost change by session size
pxpipe-gain-by-context.subtitle: pxpipe saves money only when the context is large. One session per scenario.
pxpipe-gain-by-context.desc: Diverging bar chart of the cost change when pxpipe is added after RTK, Ponytail and Headroom. Workday (7 requests, baseline peak 26k tokens): +18.0%. Long (18 requests, baseline peak 47k): -5.3%. XL (29 requests, baseline peak 303k): -27.2%.

xl-near-limit.title: Near the context limit (29 requests): cost and peak context
xl-near-limit.subtitle: Percentages compare each setup with plain Claude Code.
xl-near-limit.desc: Two bar groups for the XL session. Cost per session: plain Claude Code $4.461, RTK + Ponytail + Headroom $3.144 (-29.5%), + pxpipe always $2.288 (-48.7%), router with gain policy $1.777 (-60.2%). Peak context: plain 303.2k tokens, RTK + Ponytail + Headroom 207.9k (-31.4%), + pxpipe always 65.5k (-78.4%), router 67.9k (-77.6%).
xl-near-limit.footnote: * Router: its session read fewer files in full (7 reads vs 22 to 24), so its cost is not yet separated from session variance.

everyday.title: Everyday sessions (7 requests): cost per session, average of up to 3 sessions
everyday.subtitle: Plain Claude Code is the baseline (highlighted). Sorted cheapest first.
everyday.desc: Horizontal bars of average cost per 7-request session, sorted cheapest first. RTK + Ponytail + Headroom $0.297 (-24.9%) is cheapest; plain Claude Code $0.395 is the baseline; All six tools $0.584 (+47.9%) is most expensive.

router-decisions.title: How the router decided, request by request (XL session)
router-decisions.subtitle: Context size at each request. S is the estimated saving from the dry run (k tokens).
router-decisions.desc: Line chart of context size in thousands of tokens against request index 0 to 76, rising from 20.0k to 68.4k. Shaded zones: below 40k the router goes direct with no analysis; 40k to 100k it runs a dry run and switches only if the saving pays back within 20 requests. Dry-run savings S are annotated at requests 47 to 76, ending at 37.4k when it switched to pxpipe.
router-decisions.note: Calibrated estimate stayed within about 1% of the real size Anthropic reported.
